storyboard.concept: Confident mirror selfie outfit check showcasing embroidered lawn suit

scenes.visual: Young woman in embroidered green lawn suit standing confidently in front of full-length mirror, holding phone up to take mirror selfie, full body shot showing complete outfit
scenes.background: Modern bedroom with large floor mirror, soft natural light from window, minimalist decor, warm morning ambiance
scenes.vo: Yaar dekho yeh embroidered suit kitna gorgeous hai

scenes.visual: Same woman turns to three-quarter angle still holding phone, showing the drape and flow of the embroidered lawn fabric, confident pose
scenes.background: Same modern bedroom setting with soft natural light, mirror reflecting the outfit beautifully
scenes.vo: Iska fabric itna soft aur comfortable hai

scenes.visual: Closer waist-up shot of the same woman still holding phone, focusing on the intricate embroidery work and neckline details of the green suit
scenes.background: Soft-focus mirror reflection with warm natural lighting highlighting fabric texture
scenes.vo: Look at this embroidery work - bilkul stunning lagta hai

scenes.visual: Woman looking directly at camera through mirror with confident smile, still holding phone, showing complete styled look with the embroidered lawn suit
scenes.background: Bright modern room with mirror, natural lighting creating perfect selfie ambiance
scenes.vo: Main totally obsessed hun is outfit se

scenes.visual: Final confident pose of woman in embroidered suit holding phone up, direct eye contact with camera, full styling visible
scenes.background: Clean modern mirror setting with perfect lighting for outfit showcase
scenes.vo: Tumko bhi chahiye toh The Collection pe jaake shop karo abhi

storyboard.notes: Mirror selfie outfit check format with single confident woman showcasing embroidered lawn suit throughout, building from full reveal to detail shots ending with strong CTA, maintaining phone-up pose for authentic mirror selfie aesthetic
